online co op for twilight princess. 2 to 16 players in one world.

put crests_of_courage.dusk in dusklight's mods folder. a co op tab shows up in the menu bar.
one player presses host and reads out the room, everyone else types it and presses join.

only windows has been played. mac, linux, android and ios are built here but untested.
enemy sync, boss sync and story progress are off by default under unfinished.

this version needs dusklight 2.0.2, and everyone has to update: it only connects to 1.7.4.

this build:
- fixed other players sometimes staying invisible for the whole session (ganondorf and big custom models especially)
- fixed other players missing their head, face or hands
- fixed other players getting stuck under the map (or frozen anywhere) and never coming back, mostly with 3+ players after someone reconnected
- fixed seeing other players under the map while they're in a cutscene or loading in
- fixed getting stuck as the wolf in ordon (nobody outside, no way into the houses for the sword and shield) when you became the wolf through the other player's progress
- fixed joining someone in ordon village sending you to the credits
- fixed picking up two things at once freezing you in place
- fixed a crash when the other player held up something they just got (rupees especially)
- fixed a crash after loading in when the other player has the wooden sword on their back
- fixed enemies not syncing in rooms that loaded during a door or a cutscene
- fixed the other player's items (boomerang, bombs, lantern) disappearing after they switched models a few times
- fixed a crash when someone threw the boomerang after changing rooms (forest temple, by the wind bridges)
- the forest temple's rotating bridges stay the same for everyone: no more extra turns, and they don't stop half way
- joining late or walking into a room: levers, lifts, torches, cages and enemies already killed now show up the way they are for everyone else
- stopped the game re-sending the whole map every few seconds when two saves had different tears of light
